answer: Two strangers decide if a claim lives. At dawn the warden draws two unrelated requesters from the tundra pool, each handing it one fresh micro-job it never chose. Both must finish live within an hour, checked against the sealed reference and its kernel. One failure is a split commission: both void, fee burned, barred a week. Honest work costs five cents and two live jobs; 1,000 fakes pay $50 and must finish 2,000 jobs they cannot choose.
